identification: Two 1 imperial gallon rectangular Energol motor oil tins, The Commonwealth Oil Refineries Ltd (COR, later BP Australia), c1950s: (1) green with yellow bands, ENERGOL / MOTOR OIL / RECOMMENDED BY ROLLS-ROYCE / S.A.E. (grade blank), '1 GALLON' at top, COR text above SAE panel; scattered rust spots and paint loss on front edges and side; (2) taller Energol Visco-Static Motor Oil 'BD' tin, cream paper-look printed label with old handwriting on front, full printed instruction panel on back, 'NETT CONTENTS 1 IMPERIAL GALLON', 'THE COMMONWEALTH OIL REFINERIES LIMITED'; soiling and light rust on edges. Both have caps.
